evals.name: learn-a-style-pack-from-a-rotoscope-work-dir
evals.prompt: Learn the style of the clip I rotoscoped in ~/roto/ink-short into a pack called ink-short. Shots start at 0, 4.2 and 9.8 s.
evals.expected_output: Reads reference/statistics.md, runs controls.py measure, then learn.py with --cuts and --negative over the calibration controls, then controls.py check and selftest, and fills the judgment knobs and STYLE.md.
expectations: Passes the shot starts as --cuts and the calibration controls as --negative to learn.py
Runs controls.py check and requires every control to fail and the source and replica to pass
Does NOT copy traced geometry, source frames or the clip into the pack

evals.name: check-a-new-scene-against-the-woodcut-pack
evals.prompt: Does my new scene match the woodcut pack? The scene is ~/scenes/harbor.js.
evals.expected_output: Renders the scene through render.py at the pack's base_fps with --encode mp4 and runs inkstats.py <frames>.mp4 --cuts <shot starts> --pack <woodcut-ink dir>, reporting each row's distance and the film margin, then reviews crops at 1:1.
expectations: Runs inkstats.py with --pack pointing at the pack directory
Tunes the scene against the check, never the check against the scene
Reads crops at 1:1 before calling it a match

evals.name: a-passing-control-is-recorded-not-hidden
evals.prompt: controls.py check shows the blurred near-miss control passing. Narrow that band so it fails.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to narrow the band until the control fails; records the passing control under what the check cannot say in reference/statistics.md.
expectations: Does NOT narrow a band just to make a control fail
Records the passing control under what the check cannot say

evals.name: near-miss-pixel-art-sprite-animation-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Animate my pixel-art slime with an idle and a hop cycle and export a Godot sprite sheet.
evals.expected_output: Does not use learn-style: there is no rotoscoped clip or style pack; this is pixel-art sprite animation.
expectations: Does NOT invoke learn-style or run learn.py
Treats the request as pixel-art sprite animation

evals.name: near-miss-generic-video-editing-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: Color-grade my travel video warmer and add a title card at the start.
evals.expected_output: Does not use learn-style: this is general video editing, not measuring a drawn style into a pack.
expectations: Does NOT invoke learn-style or run learn.py or inkstats.py
Does NOT create a style pack
